findings.claim: The spec requires the cached scene to be rebuilt when the driver list changes, not only when the track changes. No test covers this. Every game test mocks createRaceScene with a stub that ignores its liveries argument, so reverting the cache key to track-only passes every test, even though the real scene would then have only 2 car meshes for a 6-car race.
findings.evidence: Mutation: in src/game.ts:82 change `const key = `${world.track.data.id}|${drivers.length}`;` to `const key = world.track.data.id;`. That makes it equivalent to the old `sceneTrack` check. No test fails. tests/game/six-car-grid.test.ts:9-12 and six-car-race.test.ts:10-13 both mock `createRaceScene: () => ({ update() {}, ... })` and never check how many times it was called or what it was called with. In the real game the steps are: `startRace({ trackId: 'dust-bowl' })`, which is 2 cars by default (e.g. via window.__racer), then RACE on the start screen on the same track, which is 6 cars. sceneFor reuses the 2-livery scene. In src/render/scene.ts:149 `for (let i = 0; i < cars.length; i++)` loops only over the 2 meshes, so cars 2–5 are simulated and shown on the minimap but never drawn.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a test in a new file (e.g. tests/game/six-car-scene.test.ts) that mocks createRaceScene with `vi.fn((_layout, liveries) => ({ ...stub }))`. Call `game.startRace({ trackId: T })`, then `game.startRace({ trackId: T, carCount: 6 })`, and assert that the mock was called again and its last call's liveries have length 6. Also assert that restarting with the same count reuses the scene: no new call, and reset() is called.

checked.how: Mutation: drop carCount from onRace (src/game.ts:75). The default of 2 then makes toHaveLength(6) fail, so the mutation is caught.

checked.target: AC1 grid geometry test vs src/sim/world.ts slots >= 4
checked.how: Over every track and seeds 1–20 the test asserts dirt surface, along < 0 and strictly decreasing, pairwise distance ≥ 4, and, for slots 4–5, lateral within halfWidth and more than 3 units clear of colliders. This covers the spec plus the plan-audit prop check.
Asserts .ui-hud-pos__value is '1/6' and the __of text is '/6' during the countdown. A non-6 count fails.
Asserts 6 circles, the sorted colour set, rally-red at index 5, and that its radius is larger than each of the others. Not trivial.

Mutation: loop only bots[0]. r.inputs[2..5] then stay NO_INPUT, the cars don't move, and the >20 unit check fails, so it is caught. Mutation: createBot(world, i+1) changed to createBot(world, 1): this would most likely break AC5/AC6 finishing and ordering.

Per track, with fixed SEED=7 (as the plan audit asked): all 6 finish ticks are non-null and ≤ 5 minutes, results rows equal NAMES ordered by sim position, AI ticks are distinct in a Set, and a rerun gives the same ticks. No trivial assertions.

Mutation: drop carCount from restart or onNextRace (game.ts:54,58). The toHaveLength(6) or '/6' checks fail. If a button is missing, `?.click()` is a no-op, but the phase 'countdown' and paused assertions then fail, so a missing button can't pass silently.
Grep in tests/game: results-drivers.test.ts:42 and pause-results.test.ts:87+ call startRace without carCount and replay a 2-car twin world, so changing the default would break them.
Grep for createRaceScene in tests: every game test stubs it without checking arguments, so the key is untested (F1).
